# Wiktionary (en.wiktionary.org)

> > A free, multilingual dictionary and language reference with 9.8 million entries covering etymology, pronunciation (IPA), grammar, and definitions across 4,500+ languages.

Wiktionary is a collaborative wiki-based dictionary providing detailed linguistic information including Proto-Indo-European etymologies, International Phonetic Alphabet pronunciations, declensions, conjugations, and usage examples. It operates under Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 and GNU Free Documentation licenses.

## Key Topics

- International Phonetic Alphabet (IPA)
- Etymology and word origins
- Proto-Indo-European linguistics
- Proto-Germanic and Proto-West Germanic
- Old English
- Grammar and declension
- Pronunciation transcription
- Latin language forms
- Dictionary entries
- Past tense and past participle
- Multilingual definitions
- Internet slang
- Basic English vocabulary
- Verb conjugation

## Getting Started

- [Wiktionary Main Page](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/Wiktionary:Main_Page): Wiktionary homepage: 9.8M entries from 4,500+ languages, free dictionary
- [International Phonetic Alphabet Guide](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/Wiktionary:International_Phonetic_Alphabet): IPA phonetic notation guide for Wiktionary pronunciation transcriptions
- [Basic English Word List](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/Appendix:Basic_English_word_list): Basic English 850-word core vocabulary list for simplified communication
- [English Internet Slang](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/Appendix:English_internet_slang): English internet slang reference: abbreviations and online communication terms

## Common Word Entries

- [what](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/what): English 'what' entry with Proto-Indo-European etymology and Germanic cognates
- [about](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/about): English 'about' entry with Old English etymology and alternative forms
- [started](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/started): English verb form entry: past tense/participle of 'start' with IPA
- [helped](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/helped): English verb form entry: past tense/participle of 'help' with IPA

## Latin Language Entries

- [pluribus](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/pluribus): Latin adjective form entry: pluribus declension with pronunciation
- [cruris](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/cruris): Latin noun form entry: genitive singular of crus
- [suspiria](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/suspiria): Latin noun form entry: plural declension of suspirium

## Specialized & International Entries

- [ø (Latin letter with stroke)](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/ø): Latin letter ø with stroke: Unicode character variations and usage
- [éternuer (French)](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/éternuer): French verb éternuer (to sneeze) with Middle French etymology
- [älykäs (Finnish)](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/älykäs): Finnish adjective älykäs (intelligent) coined by Otto Tandefelt 1836
- [stigmatophilia](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/stigmatophilia): English noun entry: paraphilia term with etymology from stigma + -philia
- [mind break](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/mind_break): English noun entry: fiction/pornography term with US audio pronunciation
